rationale: The current recurrent-tail schedule is step-based even though runs are wallclock-capped, so late-stage recurrence can stay under-activated if the launcher stops well before `ITERATIONS`. This edit preserves the current recurrent-tail and quant-aware/export family, but makes the tail curriculum follow actual train-time budget whenever `MAX_WALLCLOCK_SECONDS` is active, so the staged reverse-tail gains reliably reach their intended late-run regime on the Mac mini.
title: Wallclock-Aligned Reverse-Tail Curriculum
